name: Maximilian Brauer
bio: Maximilian Brauer is a German actor and voice artist.

credits.title: The Man Who Could Have Changed the World
credits.overview: Based upon the true story of Ranuccio Bandinelli, an antifascist Archaeology and History of Art teacher who sought to steer clear of politics but who found himself appointed, ex-officio, as Hitler and Mussolini’s official guide during their visit to Rome and Florence.

credits.title: Prosecution
credits.overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

credits.title: Janine Moves to the Country
credits.overview: Far away from the big city, Janine is unwelcome, yet an eye-catcher: a sensual, queer subject of projection with wine-red hair. Jan Eilhardt travels with her to engage with his own rural past, opening old wounds and infiltrating a hostile milieu.

credits.title: Impostor
credits.overview: Julius, an eloquent young museum attendant loved by the people around him, invites his colleagues on a sailing trip on his aristocratic family's boat, but something goes wrong. Julius is not who he seems to be.

credits.title: Why Chickens Don‘t Fly
credits.overview: An unexpected encounter with an unfamiliar woman rouses Marlene, a young single mother, from her unsatisfying routine. credits.title: Precious Ivie
credits.overview: Two Afro-German half-sisters that never met before, get closer through their father's death, search their roots and find themselves.

credits.title: Saturne
credits.overview: The magical-realist camera follows the trials and encounters of Jonathan as he attempts to fulfill his mother’s final wish: that her ashes be laid to rest at Alexanderplatz, Berlin. credits.title: Hartwig Seeler – Ein neues Leben
credits.overview: The private detective Hartwig Seeler gets an assignment from his former colleague Tascha.

credits.title: Factory Cowboys: Working with Warhol
credits.overview: Docu-fiction hybrid about Ulli Lommel and Andy Warhol.

credits.title: Julia 17
credits.overview: A story about abandonment, inner turmoil and self-recognition.

credits.title: The King's Surrender
credits.overview: Violent youth gangs and a police force way out of its depth. When a police operation goes awry and two policemen die, the powder keg threatens to ignite as the SWAT team knows only one goal: revenge - irrespective of the law.

credits.title: Polar
credits.overview: Luis pays a visit to his father in the mountains. He has not seen him for several years.
